0022600007.text: Denver opens its 2026-27 season on the road against an Oklahoma City team that hasn't played yet and still has a game at San Antonio before this one. The teams went 1-3 in Denver's favor's disfavor, meaning the Thunder took three of four meetings in 2025-26, but the Nuggets won the most recent matchup 127-107 in Denver on April 10. Spencer Jones is a game-time decision with a hamstring injury, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance to win.

0022600110.text: The Nuggets have not played a 2026-27 game yet, and they still have one game to play before this one, at Oklahoma City, while the Pelicans have yet to play a game this season and have two games ahead of this one, against Indiana and at Utah. Denver won all three of its meetings with New Orleans in 2025-26, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and no games between the two teams have been played yet this season. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver an 80% chance to win.

0022600127.text: Neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet, and Denver still has road games at Oklahoma City and home games against New Orleans ahead of this one, while Golden State has trips to the Lakers and Phoenix and a home game against Memphis to play first. The teams split their four meetings in 2025-26, and Denver's most recent win was a 116-93 home victory on March 29, 2026. Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out after knee surgery, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 70% chance to win.
